na59b791e7f.headline: Activos Healthcare buys two hospitals from FGS Saúde – Idealista / news
na59b791e7f.summary: Spanish healthcare real estate company Activos Healthcare has bought two hospitals in Portugal from FGS Saúde. The deal adds healthcare assets to its portfolio.
na59b791e7f.why: Activos Healthcare is a Spanish company investing in healthcare real estate, so acquisitions expand its rented hospital assets.

n64365b9917.headline: Philippine SEC warns against unlicensed crypto exchanges amid FTX collapse
n64365b9917.summary: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission warned against unlicensed crypto exchanges that are targeting Filipino investors through online ads and social media, amid the FTX collapse.
n64365b9917.why: The Philippine SEC regulates securities and investment offerings in the country, including crypto trading platforms. Regulatory warnings affect how crypto firms can market and operate in the market.

nc81033fa5e.headline: Analysis-Argentina's Vaca Muerta shale boom is running out of road
nc81033fa5e.summary: Argentina's Vaca Muerta shale formation, which rivals the US Permian Basin, risks running out of road as infrastructure to handle oil output lags.
nc81033fa5e.why: Vaca Muerta is one of the world's largest shale resources, and pipeline and export capacity determine how much of its output reaches markets.

nbe90e09506.headline: Eset: Number of attempts to steal personal data in the Czech Republic increased by hundreds of percent this year | ČeskéNoviny.cz
nbe90e09506.summary: Security firm Eset reported a several hundred percent increase in phishing attempts targeting personal data in the Czech Republic, with spyware programs focusing on user passwords.
nbe90e09506.why: Rising cyberattacks threaten data security and can impose costs on businesses and consumers, impacting trust in digital finance and commerce.

ne1e83af929.why: Tax system modernization affects government revenue collection and business compliance processes.

ne9542ea4af.summary: Shell agreed to pay 15 million euros to Nigerian communities affected by multiple oil pipeline leaks in the Niger Delta region.
ne9542ea4af.why: Shell is a major global oil company; settlements over environmental damage affect its financials and reputation, with implications for oil sector risk management.
